node.title: Re: Deleting hash entry
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
I don't want the hash entries where single digit numbers are keys

You can [doc://delete] a hash [doc://perldata#Slices|slice]:

delete @hash{0..9};

Note that because your question isn't directly related to [id://315063|the OP], and the OP is ~13 years old, it would have been better if this was posted as a new question, which is why I've considered your node. Update: Node has since been reparented, and I added link to the original parent node.
